rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Nernst at 298 K: E = E° − (0.0591/n)·log([products]/[reactants]) — for the cell, use the reaction quotient Q of the OVERALL cell reaction.  ·  Trick 2: Pure solids/liquids and 1 M standard states drop out of Q — only ion concentrations appear for metal–metal-ion electrodes.
